combat.eyebrow: No Extraction. No Guns. No Pay-to-Win.
combat.title: PURE SKILL COMBAT
combat.body: OKUBI is pure skill and PvP. No clock, no forced extraction. Just you, your team, and the arena. Various game modes and more to come in the future.

email.title: Building Okubi Together
email.body: Hey there! My name is Skeltonjohn and I'm the solo dev behind OKUBI. I want to keep the line directly open between us so join in and drop your email to get dev updates, early playtest invites, and a direct say in where the game goes next. No marketing fluff—just real progress and a front-row seat to the journey.
email.success: You're in! We'll keep you posted.
